description: 1KOMMA5° At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it? We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. Learn more about our Product & Tech team! Your mission Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As the ( Senior) Go-to-Market Scaling Manager - Germany, your first focus is optimising the performance, positioning, and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within our largest and most established market while adding new products to it and making sure our new customer-facing features get seen. You will take ownership of what's already working and what isn't, fine-tuning pricing, packaging, and go-to-market execution while working closely across Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing to keep the German market performing at its full potential. You own the performance and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within the German market, working to continuously optimise what's already in place rather than build from zero. You fine-tune pricing and packaging, identify where existing structures are leaving value on the table, and drive the changes needed to capture it. You bring new positioning ideas to an already mature market, testing and validating fresh angles alongside the initiatives already running. You develop a deep understanding of the unit economics behind Heartbeat AI in Germany, using that insight to shape monetisation strategy across pricing, packaging, and the broader product suite. You work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders, translating technical constraints into commercial decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements. You track performance across the German market, using data to spot where monetisation or positioning is underperforming and turning that into concrete action. You operate with significant cross-functional influence, managing diagonally across tech, sales, and marketing to keep initiatives moving. You report into the Go-to-Market Director, working closely with senior leadership to present performance updates and build the case for changes to positioning or monetisation strategy. Your profile You bring at least 5 years of experience in a similar commercial, product, or GTM role, ideally within the tech and energy industry. You are confident optimising an already-established market, spotting where fine-tuning pricing, packaging, or positioning can unlock further performance. You are structured by default and follow through without being asked: you manage multiple concurrent initiatives and dependencies without losing the thread, and own action items end to end. You are ambitious and impact-driven, yet humble and a strong influencer in equal measure. You set a high bar for what "good" looks like, quickly credit the team and admit when something isn't working, and can bring sceptical stakeholders on board to inspire the cross-functional effort to scale the German market. You have a strong grasp of unit economics and a genuine passion for how they drive monetisation decisions, and you can translate margin and cost-structure insights into concrete pricing and product strategy. You are comfortable working closely with Tech, Sales and Marketing teams and fluent in both sales/marketing and technology language, translating technical trade-offs into business decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements, without needing someone else to broker the conversation. You are confident presenting to and working directly with executives and can turn data and KPIs into clear, decision-ready updates. You are native in German and fluent in English (C1/C2), written and verbal. Knowledge of and experience in the German energy market is clearly a plus, but not a must. Unser Mandant ist ein erfolgreiches und renommiertes Bauunternehmen mit langjähriger Erfahrung in der Realisierung anspruchsvoller Hochbauprojekte. Das Unternehmen steht für Qualität, Innovationskraft und eine partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen. Dank einer hervorragenden Auftragslage und einer nachhaltigen Unternehmensstrategie werden spannende Projekte im Wohnungs-, Gewerbe- und Bürobau erfolgreich umgesetzt. Zur weiteren Verstärkung des Teams suchen wir einen Senior Bauleiter Hochbau (m/w/d), der Verantwortung übernimmt und Projekte mit Leidenschaft zum Erfolg führt.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Leitung und Steuerung anspruchsvoller Hochbauprojekte von der Baustelleneinrichtung bis zur Übergabe

  • Ausgeprägte Führungs- und Kommunikationsstärke
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise


Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in einem wirtschaftlich starken und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen
  • Attraktive Vergütung mit zusätzlichen Benefits und Entwicklungsperspektiven

Unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit analytischer Stärke, belastbarem Netzwerk und ausgezeichnetem kaufmännischem Verständnis. Benefits Eigentümerperspektive statt reine Verwaltung: Gestalten Sie Immobilienstrategien aktiv mit und treffen Sie Entscheidungen mit direktem Einfluss auf den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg des Portfolios. Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit echter Wohlfühlatmosphäre: Helle Büros, hochwertige Arbeitsplätze und ein Umfeld, das produktives Arbeiten fördert. Koordination sämtlicher Projektbeteiligter, darunter Architekten, Fachplaner, Behörden, Gutachter und ausführende Unternehmen. Sicherstellung der baurechtlichen Voraussetzungen sowie Begleitung von Genehmigungs- und Abstimmungsprozessen mit relevanten Stakeholdern. Fundierte Kenntnisse in der wirtschaftlichen, technischen und rechtlichen Bewertung von Immobilienprojekten. Unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Verhandlungsgeschick, Marktverständnis und strategischem Weitblick. Benefits Projekte mit echter Strahlkraft: Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Immobilienentwicklungen und begleiten Sie Projekte, die das Stadtbild nachhaltig prägen. Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigene Ideen, unternehmerisches Denken und Eigenverantwortung sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden aktiv gefördert. Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Einfluss: Arbeiten Sie in einem Umfeld, in dem Entscheidungen schnell getroffen und Projekte effizient vorangetrieben werden. Attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive Firmenwagen: Neben einer leistungsorientierten Vergütung profitieren Sie von einem Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung sowie weiteren Zusatzleistungen. Moderne Arbeitswelt mit hoher Flexibilität: Mobiles Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine ausgezeichnete Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben schaffen optimale Rahmenbedingungen. Langfristige Entwicklungsperspektiven: Individuelle Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen, spannende Projekte und hervorragende Karrierechancen bieten die ideale Grundlage für Ihre weitere berufliche Entwicklung. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value. TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. We are now hiring a Managing Director (Geschäftsführer, m/w/d) of TULIP GmbH , who will also be TULIP's Commercial Leader for DACH. Reporting to the Head of Global General Manufacturing Sales with governance reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will own the DACH region's growth, lead the local team, and represent TULIP to customers, partners and employees. About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its Series D at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. 

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments.

We are now hiring a Managing Director (Geschäftsführer, m/w/d) of TULIP GmbH, who will also be TULIP's Commercial Leader for DACH. Reporting to the Head of Global General Manufacturing Sales with governance reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will own the DACH region's growth, lead the local team, and represent TULIP to customers, partners and employees. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description: Agents are authoring entire data systems. The bottleneck is no longer writing pipelines, but understanding, governing, and trusting what they produce. dltHub provides the infrastructure that enables data teams in large enterprises and scale-up companies to run their data stack autonomously. Our open-source Python library, dlt, offers agents and developers transparent, composable building blocks for data ingestion (schema inference, normalization, incremental loading, and data contracts), designed from the start for the AI era. Built on dlt, dltHub is the AI-native data engineering platform for teams of humans and agents: a managed layer over any warehouse that lets both your team and their agents generate, validate, and manage high-quality data at scale. As we grow, product communication and sales collateral are critical for our success. We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager to lead building the bridge between our customers and our product team. Mission of the Role Make dltHub as compelling to business leaders as it is to engineers, and drive enterprise opportunities through a strong message, launches, and enterprise-level communication. What you'll actually work on Product Launches. You own the process and delivery of our product launches and ensure we communicate our product vision and new product capabilities consistently to a growing audience. We launch new products every few weeks. Recent examples include the public preview of Transformations , a companion post for practitioners , dltHub Pro , dltHub for Teams , and our vision for an autonomous data platform . Enterprise communication. You ensure we are speaking with one voice and represent our brand consistently in everything we say and do. You take ownership of our website communications. Customer collateral. You take our customer success stories and blueprints, like the  ontology and semantic layer , to the next level of excellence. These come from engagements with our customers and our Solutions Engineering team. You interview the customer and write them. Content marketing. You coordinate our content marketing creation and distribution efforts. Work with our content writers. Plan the schedules and ensure that the content speaks our language The link between Product and GTM. You align stakeholders, drive the launch schedule, and close gaps in messaging, sales enablement, and launch readiness. Coordinate our product marketing activities and keep the team aligned. What success looks like: In 90 days, you run launches end to end, and our story is consistent across the website, sales collateral, and decks, with messaging that speaks directly to business buyers. In 6 months, you've built a repeatable process that trains sales on that story, and we can see it working (e.g. in win rate with business buyers & deal velocity) Ongoing, you own the marketing plan: one lean, visible roadmap where everyone can see what we're doing, why, and in what order. Requirements You can write clearly about technical subjects. Your style is clear and not full of marketing talk. Please read the post on the Transformations launch and the page at dlthub.com/security . If you think you can do better, you are the person we're looking for. You have been targeting US enterprise customers and are therefore familiar with what a senior technical stakeholder actually reads. title: Product Owner (m/w/d) - Customer Domain
description: Über uns Seit 2008 arbeiten wir mit unseren vier Marken doctari, lichtfeld, Planerio und arztpool an unserer Vision, medizinisches Personal dorthin zu bringen, wo es am dringendsten benötigt wird. doctari pro ist unsere B2B-Buchungsplattform für Personalverantwortliche in Krankenhäusern und Gesundheitseinrichtungen und die zentrale Schnittstelle zur Demand-Seite unseres Marktplatzes. Über doctari pro können Ärztinnen und Ärzte unkompliziert gefunden, angefragt und gebucht werden: in Arbeitnehmerüberlassung oder befristeter Anstellung. Als Gegenstück zur doctari App auf der Kandidatenseite ist doctari pro ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres zweiseitigen Marktplatzes. Deine neue Rolle Als Product Owner (m/w/d) im Customer Domain Team übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Wachstumshebel unseres Unternehmens. Gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team gestaltest du die Produktstrategie ebenso aktiv mit wie die Umsetzung neuer Features und bringst moderne Technologien wie KI gezielt in die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro ein. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering, UX Design und internen Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst fundierte Produktentscheidungen auf Basis von Nutzerdaten, technischen Anforderungen und Marktanforderungen. Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team innovative Features für Kliniken und Gesundheitseinrichtungen, von der Anfrage bis zur Buchung. Du priorisierst das Product Backlog anhand von Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktanforderungen und relevanten Produkt-KPIs. Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der Product Discovery über Delivery bis zum erfolgreichen Release. Du arbeitest mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen und übersetzt Marktanforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen. Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Buchungsdaten, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und optimierst kontinuierlich die Customer Journey auf doctari pro. Du treibst den gezielten Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Produkt voran. Deine Erfahrung & Persönlichkeit Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS-, Plattform- oder Marketplace-Umfeld. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte für Geschäftskunden: von der Product Discovery über nutzerzentriertes Design bis zur datengetriebenen Optimierung. Technisches Verständnis, das tief genug geht, um Architekturentscheidungen zu verstehen, Trade-offs zu bewerten und mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren. Analytisches Denken, Pragmatismus sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Produkte und moderne Technologien, die du aktiv nutzt, um Produktmehrwert zu schaffen. Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Account Management oder Customer Success ist ein klares Plus. Sehr gute Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab. Das erwartet Dich Bei uns übernimmst du echte Produktverantwortung für doctari pro, eine Plattform mit direktem Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität im deutschen Gesundheitssystem. Du gestaltest die Demand-Seite eines der größten medizinischen Marktplätze Deutschlands mit und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit unmittelbar in den Daten. title: Director Product (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Unsere Produkte sind der Grund, warum Kund:innen bei uns kaufen und immer wieder zurückkommen. Als Director Product (m/w/d) verantwortest du alles, was dahintersteht, für alle Marken der SNOCKS Group: von der ersten Produktidee über Sourcing und Produktion bis zur Lieferung ins Lager. Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain aber auch Quality Management und ESG sind dein Kern, und genau dort bist du strategisch wie operativ tief drin. Du setzt die Richtung, führst die Heads und ihre Teams und hältst die Fäden über alle Abteilungen hinweg zusammen. Wenn es darauf ankommt, sitzt du selbst mit am Tisch der Supplier. Kurz: Du bist die Person, die unser Produkt-Business nach vorne bringt, mit Weitblick und mit beiden Händen im Tagesgeschäft. Deine Aufgaben Produktstrategie : Du entwickelst mit den PD-Heads und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CEO Rehan die Produkt- und Sortimentsstrategie für unsere Marken, bewertest neue Kategorien und übersetzt alles in eine klare Roadmap. Product Development: Du steuerst die Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Launches, challengst Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten erfolgreiche Produkte werden. Sourcing & Supplier Management : Du verantwortest unsere Supplier-Landschaft, vor allem in China und Pakistan, baust eigene, belastbare Beziehungen auf und verhandelst Preise, Qualität und Timings gemeinsam mit unserem Supply Chain Team. Den Aufbau von Direct Sourcing treibst du strategisch voran. Supply Chain: Du sorgst für eine stabile, effiziente Lieferkette von der Bestellung bis zur Ware im Lager und erkennst Engpässe, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Performance & Zahlen: Du hast die Performance der Brands und neuer Launches im Blick, gehst in Product Deep Dives und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten. Leadership : Du führst die Heads sowie die Teams aus Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality Management und ESG mit Empathie, klaren Zielen und ehrlichem Feedback. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen und du entwickelst die Menschen weiter. Krisen- & Konfliktmanagement: Wenn es intern oder bei Suppliern brennt, bleibst du ruhig, deeskalierst und findest Lösungen. Prozesse & Workflows: Du baust Strukturen, die wirklich funktionieren, und machst unseren Produktbereich skalierbar. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du bist Schnittstelle zu fast allen Bereichen der Gruppe, von Brand und E-Commerce über Marketplace bis Finance, und bist Sparringspartner:in für Rehan. Dein Profil Studium : Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Textilmanagement oder ein vergleichbarer Hintergrund. Noch wichtiger ist uns, was du in deiner Laufbahn schon aufgebaut und bewegt hast. Erfahrung : Mindestens 8 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung in Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain, idealerweise in der Textilbranche. Leadership-Erfahrung : Du hast bereits Teams und Führungskräfte geführt und tust das mit Empathie, Klarheit und echtem Interesse an den Menschen. Product Development : Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in der Produktentwicklung mit, von der Idee über Sampling bis zur Serienreife, und erkennst, was ein Produkt erfolgreich macht. Sourcing & Supply Chain : Du hast Supplier-Landschaften bereits aktiv gesteuert, kennst Produktions- und Lieferprozesse im Detail und kannst Kosten, Qualität und Timings fachlich challengen. QM & Sustainability : Du hast ein solides Grundverständnis für Qualitätsmanagement und Nachhaltigkeit. Strategie & Hands-on : Du denkst strategisch, arbeitest aber genauso gern operativ mit, vor allem in der Supplier-Kommunikation. Ins kalte Wasser zu springen schreckt dich nicht ab. Verhandlungsstärke : Du verhandelst souverän und selbstbewusst, auch dann, wenn es ungemütlich wird. Sourcing-Netzwerk : Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Direct Sourcing oder Erfahrung im Aufbau davon ist ein dickes Plus. Erfahrung mit Produktion in China und Pakistan ebenso. Mindset : Du sagst klar deine Meinung, übernimmst Ownership wie für dein eigenes Business und gehst mit viel Freiraum verantwortungsvoll um. Reisebereitschaft & Präsenz : Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort in Mannheim und Berlin und reist gern zu unseren Suppliern, bei Bedarf auch spontan. Sprachen : Sehr sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Warum wir? Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen. Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst. Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt : Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget. Echte Flexibilität : Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden. Onboarding : Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen. Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst. Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun : Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub. Alle zusammen: Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work. Office-Leben: Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office! Wir kleiden dich ein: Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits. #LI-Remote Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Venture Developer (m/f/d)
description: Transparenz vorab: Das hier ist die Venture-Developer-Rolle – eine Festanstellung mit 60–75k € Jahresgehalt, je nach Erfahrung. Sie ist NICHT die Founder-/Geschäftsführer-Rolle: Wenn du direkt als Gründer:in ein Venture übernehmen willst (volle Geschäftsführungs-Verantwortung von Tag 1), bewirb dich auf unsere separate Co-Founder-Anzeige. Als Venture Developer kannst du dich über ca. zwei Jahre in genau diesen Founder-Track hineinentwickeln. So läuft unser Prozess – kein Schritt ohne zeitnahe Rückmeldung: 1. Kennenlern-Call (20–30 Min.), 2. Big-Five-Assessment auf unserer eigenen Plattform (15–20 Min.), 3. kurzer Partner-Call (20 Min.), 4. Case Study mit Deep-Dive, 5. Referenzen & Angebot. Zum Arbeitsort: Die Rolle startet remote (Deutschland). Wir bauen aber ein Office in Deutschland auf – vorzugsweise Berlin oder München –, dort entstehen die Venture-Teams, und dort erwarten wir dich regelmäßig vor Ort, spätestens mit deinem Team. Aufgaben Venture Development: Du identifizierst, strukturierst und validierst neue Geschäftsmodelle – von der Idee bis zum belastbaren Setup. Testing & Iteration: Du entwickelst MVPs, testest Hypothesen im Markt und optimierst kontinuierlich. Operative Umsetzung: Du baust erste Prozesse, gewinnst Kunden und bringst Ventures in die frühe Traktion. Scaling Readiness: Du bereitest erfolgreiche Modelle auf Skalierung oder Ausgründung vor. Optional – Founder Track: Du kannst ein Venture als Co-Founder übernehmen und langfristig führen. Qualifikation Erfahrung im Aufbau von Projekten, Startups oder neuen Geschäftsbereichen Starke analytische und unternehmerische Denkweise gepaart mit hoher Umsetzungsstärke Fähigkeit, schnell von Konzept zu Execution zu kommen Hohe Eigenmotivation und Ownership Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Offenheit für unterschiedliche Branchen und Geschäftsmodelle (inkl. „unsexy“ Märkte) Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Benefits Direkter Impact: Du arbeitest an mehreren Venture-Ideen mit echtem Umsetzungsspielraum Founder-Option: Möglichkeit zur Ausgründung mit Beteiligung – realistisch nach ca. 2 Jahren Ressourcen & Setup: Zugang zu Kapital, Infrastruktur, Playbooks und Netzwerk Erfahrenes Team: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Unternehmern und Investoren Klare Philosophie: Fokus auf profitable, nachhaltige Geschäftsmodelle statt „Growth at all costs“ Wichtig – dein Anschreiben ist bei uns keine Formalie, sondern der erste Schritt im Auswahlprozess. Beantworte darin bitte diese drei Fragen (max. 5 Zeilen pro Antwort): 1. Was ist das Unternehmerischste, das du je getan hast – und was kam dabei heraus? 2. Beschreibe deinen größten beruflichen Rückschlag und was du seitdem anders machst. 3. Warum EBIT Ventures – und warum jetzt? Transparenz vorab: Das hier ist die Venture-Developer-Rolle – eine Festanstellung mit 60–75k € Jahresgehalt, je nach Erfahrung. Sie ist NICHT die Founder-/Geschäftsführer-Rolle: Wenn du direkt als Gründer:in ein Venture übernehmen willst (volle Geschäftsführungs-Verantwortung von Tag 1), bewirb dich auf unsere separate Co-Founder-Anzeige. Als Venture Developer kannst du dich über ca. zwei Jahre in genau diesen Founder-Track hineinentwickeln.

So läuft unser Prozess – kein Schritt ohne zeitnahe Rückmeldung: 1. Kennenlern-Call (20–30 Min.), 2. Big-Five-Assessment auf unserer eigenen Plattform (15–20 Min.), 3. kurzer Partner-Call (20 Min.), 4. Case Study mit Deep-Dive, 5. Referenzen & Angebot.

Zum Arbeitsort: Die Rolle startet remote (Deutschland). Wir bauen aber ein Office in Deutschland auf – vorzugsweise Berlin oder München –, dort entstehen die Venture-Teams, und dort erwarten wir dich regelmäßig vor Ort, spätestens mit deinem Team.

Aufgaben

  • Venture Development: Du identifizierst, strukturierst und validierst neue Geschäftsmodelle – von der Idee bis zum belastbaren Setup.
  • Testing & Iteration: Du entwickelst MVPs, testest Hypothesen im Markt und optimierst kontinuierlich.
  • Operative Umsetzung: Du baust erste Prozesse, gewinnst Kunden und bringst Ventures in die frühe Traktion.
  • Scaling Readiness: Du bereitest erfolgreiche Modelle auf Skalierung oder Ausgründung vor.
  • Optional – Founder Track: Du kannst ein Venture als Co-Founder übernehmen und langfristig führen.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Projekten, Startups oder neuen Geschäftsbereichen
  • Starke analytische und unternehmerische Denkweise gepaart mit hoher Umsetzungsstärke
  • Fähigkeit, schnell von Konzept zu Execution zu kommen
  • Hohe Eigenmotivation und Ownership
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Offenheit für unterschiedliche Branchen und Geschäftsmodelle (inkl. „unsexy“ Märkte)
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Direkter Impact: Du arbeitest an mehreren Venture-Ideen mit echtem Umsetzungsspielraum
  • Founder-Option: Möglichkeit zur Ausgründung mit Beteiligung – realistisch nach ca. 2 Jahren
  • Ressourcen & Setup: Zugang zu Kapital, Infrastruktur, Playbooks und Netzwerk
  • Erfahrenes Team: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Unternehmern und Investoren
  • Klare Philosophie: Fokus auf profitable, nachhaltige Geschäftsmodelle statt „Growth at all costs“

Wichtig – dein Anschreiben ist bei uns keine Formalie, sondern der erste Schritt im Auswahlprozess. Beantworte darin bitte diese drei Fragen (max. 5 Zeilen pro Antwort):

1. Was ist das Unternehmerischste, das du je getan hast – und was kam dabei heraus?

2. Beschreibe deinen größten beruflichen Rückschlag und was du seitdem anders machst.

3. Warum EBIT Ventures – und warum jetzt?

Bewerbungen ohne Antworten auf diese drei Fragen können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Partnerships Lead - AI Startup
description: About Logicc Bei Logicc bauen wir die KI-Plattform für Unternehmen, in denen Vertrauen, Datenschutz und Kontrolle den Arbeitsalltag prägen: von Kanzleien und Healthcare über den Public Sector bis Finance. Wir bringen führende KI-Modelle sicher in den Arbeitsalltag, damit Teams schneller arbeiten und sensible Informationen geschützt bleiben. Die Marktnachfrage ist immens und das Produkt ist zukunftsentscheidend. Was in regulierten Branchen den Unterschied macht, ist die sichere Infrastruktur und das Vertrauen in die Menschen hinter dem Produkt. Für Letzteres suchen wir dich. Aufgaben Als Partnerships Lead baust du strategische Partnerschaften auf, aktivierst unser Partnernetzwerk und entwickelst daraus messbare Pipeline für Logicc. Du verbindest Partner, Sales und Product und sorgst dafür, dass Logicc erfolgreich im Markt eingesetzt wird. Unsere Partner stehen regelmäßig im Austausch mit ihren Kunden und sind deshalb ein wichtiger Hebel für unsere Entwicklung. Du befähigst sie, Logicc sicher zu verstehen, überzeugend zu präsentieren und erfolgreich bei Kunden einzuführen. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich unter anderem in aktivierten Partnern, qualifizierten Opportunities, aufgebauter Partner-Pipeline und erfolgreichen gemeinsamen Kundenprojekten. Partnergewinnung: Du identifizierst relevante Partner, sprichst sie an und führst erste Gespräche über gemeinsame Potenziale. Onboarding & Enablement: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams Use Cases, Demos, Trainings, Sales-Unterlagen und Einwandbehandlungen, mit denen Partner Logicc erfolgreich positionieren können. Partneraktivierung: Du führst Partner von der Registrierung zur ersten qualifizierten Opportunity und baust mit ihnen eine regelmäßige Pipeline auf. Außerdem entwickelst du mit dem Team zusammen Schulungskonzepte, die unsere Partner anwenden können. Partnermanagement: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Partnerportfolio, priorisierst deine Aktivitäten selbst und entscheidest, welche Partnerschaften den größten strategischen und kommerziellen Wert für Logicc haben. Co-Selling & Übergaben: Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Partnern und unserem Sales-Team von der ersten Opportunity bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Partnerschaftspflege: Du hältst Partner über Produktentwicklungen und unsere Roadmap auf dem Laufenden, beantwortest Fragen und bist die erste Ansprechperson für strategische Themen. Voice of the Partner: Du sammelst Erkenntnisse aus Partner- und Kundengesprächen und bringst sie in Product, Marketing, Sales und Customer Success ein. Entwicklungspotential: Du bringst deine eigene Erfahrung und Kreativität mit ein und bringst unserer Partnerships und dich selbst damit aufs nächste Level und noch weiter. Qualifikation Wen wir suchen Du hast bereits 2- 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau von Partnerschaften und deren weiterentwicklung und kannst zeigen, wie du bereits erfolgreich Partner aktiviert, gemeinsame Opportunities entwickelt und neue Prozesse etabliert hast. Du kommunizierst klar, sicher und verbindlich, auf Deutsch mit unseren Partnern und auf Englisch im Team. Du fühlst dich im AI-Umfeld wohl, interessierst dich für neue AI-Tools und hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis dafür, wie sie im Arbeitsalltag eingesetzt werden können. Du kannst dich schnell in Produkte, neue Themen und unterschiedliche Zielgruppen hineindenken. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn sich Prioritäten verändern. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und kannst dich in die Perspektive von Partnern und deren Kunden hineinversetzen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, setzt klare Prioritäten und baust Strukturen auf, wo sie noch fehlen. Dabei verbindest du strategisches Denken mit konsequenter Umsetzung. Benefits Kompetetive Vergütung Apple-Setup und moderner SaaS-Stack EGYM Wellpass Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Mittagessen, Snacks, Proteinpulver und Kaffee im Office Das Umfeld Unser zentrales HQ liegt in Hamburg. Dich erwartet ein junges, ambitioniertes Team mit kurzem Draht zu den Gründern. Wir treffen Entscheidungen in Tagen statt in Quartalen und geben dir früh Verantwortung. title: Finanzbuchhalter/in (m/w/d)
description: Seit 2017 verändert HiSERV den GSE-Markt durch hervorragende Qualität, hohe Flexibilität sowie faire und transparente Preise. Wir steuern und bieten unseren Kunden eine junge und moderne Flotte, die den vielfältigen Anforderungen der Luftfahrtbranche gerecht wird. Mit Kurzzeitmiete, Pay-per-Use und Echtzeit-Tracking erfüllen wir die Anforderungen unserer Kunden optimal. Zu unseren Kunden zählen renommierte Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Ground Handling, Airlines und Flughäfen in Europa. Durch den Einsatz innovativer digitaler Lösungen liefern wir zuverlässige Daten zur Optimierung von Nutzung und Kosten. Darüber hinaus bieten wir ein breites Portfolio ergänzender Dienstleistungen rund um die GSE-Vermietung, darunter Beratung, Wartung, Flottenmanagement, Schulungen und weitere Serviceleistungen. Wir suchen am Standort Schönefeld bei Berlin zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n Finanzbuchhalter/in (m/w/d) Deine Aufgaben: Bearbeitung und Überwachung der Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung. Prüfung, Verbuchung und Nachverfolgung von Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen. Überwachung und Erfassung von Kosten im Zusammenhang mit Wartung, Reparaturen, Ersatzteilen und Arbeitsleistungen. Sicherstellung einer termingerechten Rechnungsbearbeitung und Zahlungsabwicklung. Unterstützung bei Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen. Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien sowie gesetzlicher und steuerlicher Vorgaben. Mitwirkung bei internen und externen Audits. Pflege und Dokumentation von Finanzdaten sowie Erstellung von Auswertungen und Berichten für das Management. Dein Profil: Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Bereich Rechnungswesen, Finanzen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet oder eine vergleichbare abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung. Mindestens 1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finanz- oder Rechnungswesen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Excel-und IT-Affinität wünschenswert. Erste Berührungspunkte in gängiger Buchhaltungssoftware von Vorteil (z. B. MS Dynamics). Hohe Detailgenauigkeit, analytisches Denkvermögen sowie ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Wir bieten: 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr. Attraktive Vergütung mit zusätzlichem Bonussystem. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten. Moderne Arbeitsplätze in zeitgemäßen Büroräumlichkeiten. Kostenfreie Parkplätze direkt vor Ort. Hervorragende Erreichbarkeit mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Kostenfreier Zugang zu Nilo Health für Ihre mentale Gesundheit. Regelmäßige Teamevents und gemeinsame Unternehmensveranstaltungen. Ein kollegiales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und offener Unternehmenskultur. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

This high-impact team builds and operates the utility backbone of our energy platform, combining expertise in data platforms, data engineering, and business intelligence. You'll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, creating an environment where engineers thrive and do their best work. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will lead an established and growing group of talented engineers.

At trawa, our culture is generally "office-first with flexibility", where most of us are in our beautiful Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to occasionally work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, spending minimum 3 days a week in the office.

  • Own the roadmap for our central data warehouse and the data platform that our products are built on

  • Build a scalable data backend for the key processes of an energy provider including timeseries data management, invoicing and billing services.

With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <h2 id="role-summary" data-line="3">Role Summary</h2> <p data-line="5">Firmus Technologies is seeking a skilled Infrastructure Automation Engineer to join our Commissioning team. The position will play a crucial role in the development, maintenance, and improvement of the software tools involved in the commissioning process from initial power-on through integration, phased bring-up, component and system testing, benchmarking, and acceptance testing to hand-over to operations. These tools are used by internal teams, partners, and vendors working together to transform physically built infrastructure into a production-ready platform. This role involves custom tool development, integration with a wide variety of other closed-source and open-source tools, cloud services, and SaaS platforms. We are deploying leading edge AI Factory technology and the tools supporting the commissioning process are critical for successful on-time delivery. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI technology and contribute to the growth of AI infrastructure.</p> <h2 id="key-responsibilities" data-line="7">Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3 id="hardware-bring-up" data-line="9">Hardware bring-up</h3> <p data-line="10">In collaboration with internal teams, partners, and vendors, develop custom tools and automate processes for initial system bring-up, hardware configuration, firmware updates, system inventory, testing, and issue tracking. Create accompanying documentation to support the team throughout the commissioning process, for the operations team once the system goes into production, and to accelerate future projects.</p> <h3 id="system-and-status-monitoring" data-line="12">System and status monitoring</h3> <p data-line="13">Work with vendors to implement, configure, and adapt system and status monitoring tools suitable for implementation early in the commissioning phase. Implement health-checks and diagnostics tools which assist remediation teams in finding root cause and resolving issues. Adapt these tools for new platforms, new features, new metrics, and prepare for integration into production systems.</p> <h3 id="network-tools" data-line="15">Network tools</h3> <p data-line="16">Commissioning of the network also requires suitable tools and processes, which need to be automated and streamlined. In close collaboration with the networking team, vendors, and partners implement suitable tools and an efficient process from initial power-on and OS deployment to firmware updates and network configuration. In addition, develop and implement suitable diagnostics and monitoring tools which are critical to resolve issues from the physical layer through to the application layer.</p> <h3 id="storage" data-line="18">Storage</h3> <p data-line="19">Develop tooling and automation frameworks supporting deployment, configuration, benchmarking, and validation of storage platforms.</p> <h3 id="communication-tools" data-line="21">Communication tools</h3> <p data-line="22">Efficient and effective communication between various teams involved in the commissioning process needs to be supported by suitable tools. Experience</h2> <ul data-line="44"> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li>5+ years of experience developing software, automation platforms, operational tooling, or infrastructure automation solutions for large-scale Linux, cloud, HPC, or AI environments.</li> <li>Solid understanding of advanced hardware technologies, particularly high performance GPU infrastructure, high end network environments, and high performance storage solutions.</li> <li>Experience in Linux systems including server, network, and storage configuration.</li> <li>Experience developing production software tools and APIs, consuming and integrating REST APIs, applying modern software development practices, building automated testing frameworks.</li> <li>Experience using scripting, automation, and IaC tools including bash, Python, Ansible.</li> <li>Experience using infrastructure tools and APIs including Redfish, IPMI, DCGM, Prometheus, Grafana, NetBox, etc.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI and HPC tooling such as Slurm, NVIDIA DCGM, NCCL, Kubernetes, and distributed system validation frameworks.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and as part of a team.</li> <li>Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Willingness to undertake international and/or domestic travel for on-site deployments and commissioning as required.</li> </ul> <h2 id="location-reporting" data-line="58">Location &amp; Working as one connected team, we solve complex challenges and stay accountable from strategy through to delivery, adoption and ongoing improvement.&nbsp;</p> <p>We help organisations build secure, well governed foundations, leverage more from their technology and unlock new opportunities through innovation and AI. Our focus is on making technology work in the real world and delivering lasting value.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>THE ROLE</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll be part of the Delivery Management Team in Kerv Digital.&nbsp;</p> <p>At Kerv Digital, we help organisations unlock the power of technology to transform how they work, engage customers and drive business value. We combine deep expertise across Microsoft Business Applications, Power Platform, AI, DevOps, Data and cloud technologies. With a strong focus on outcomes and real-world value, we make digital transformation feel tangible, purposeful and fast-moving.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who we are looking for:</strong></p> <p>A politically tuned, programme delivery wizard who can establish and control several streams of work across multi-year engagements; balancing the needs of each work stream against the programme objectives and stakeholder needs. You’ll be responsible for running your programme and project teams and reporting into the Delivery Management leadership team and the operational board on programme status.</p> <p>All backgrounds will always be considered and experience here is far more important, we’re really open to Programme Managers that have a solid transferable background looking to deliver a mix of well governed Business Transformation, Dynamics 365 delivery, Bespoke Development projects and programmes, with a blend of agile and waterfall approaches as appropriate.&nbsp; We’re looking for someone that will take responsibility for their programmes, as well as rescue and turnaround projects that have hit a roadblock (it happens occasionally!)</p> <p>This is also a line management position with responsibility for the pastoral care and career development of a small number of our amazing Delivery Managers and Scrum Masters.</p> <p><strong>Required Experience: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Creating and maintaining the environment in which the programme will succeed</li> <li>Making sure programmes, workstreams and projects are delivered beyond expectations</li> <li>Managing short- and long-term objectives and ensuring programmes track against these milestones.</li> <li>Establishing and operating governance structures within programmes to ensure effective decision making and robust assurance.</li> <li>Managing senior stakeholders both within Kerv Digital and our clients.</li> <li>Reporting programme status to the Kerv Digital Leadership Team and the client.</li> <li>Meeting customers, listening carefully and understanding their business</li> <li>Working with on/off-shore development/implementation teams</li> <li>Managing programme and project cost and time tracking</li> <li>Identifying and delivering change control and upsell</li> <li>Wrestling detailed requirements and designs into an implementable plan</li> <li>Managing an agile development process, directly and indirectly through our delivery managers and scrum masters</li> <li>Line management of a small team</li> <li>Ability to step into a project that needs to be reset, working with the stakeholders and the project team to turn things around</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’re also looking for people that fit how we work, which is something like; </strong></p> <ul> <li>happiest working under their own direction, but fully supported when needed</li> <li>an obvious attention to detail, we want you to obsess about the little things!</li> <li>an escalation handler, able to achieve win-win outcomes by utilising the skills across the team</li> <li>ability to work effectively with remote teams in India / UK</li> <li>ability to work flexibly to deliver on-time to tight timescales</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we can do for you:</strong> <br>We’re a transparent, honest and fiercely equal employer that believes completely in providing the best possible work experience for our employee’s: &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Real Flexibility</strong>&nbsp;– A healthy approach for most of our teams seems to be splitting three ways between home, customer sites and the office.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Awesome Environment</strong>&nbsp;– all of our employee’s will tell you that we foster an easy going environment, are experts at what we do and care deeply about what we work on – the company was started specifically to find a way for people to take more enjoyment from their work.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Interesting Work</strong>&nbsp;– these days most of our customers are household names and many of our projects have an important impact on the world around us. Being a part of Kerv means embracing a culture of innovation, collaboration, and mutual respect. Our recruitment decisions are based solely on skills, experience, qualifications and business needs, and we provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process where required.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>You will live the Kerv values…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Think Customer First</li> <li>Team is everything</li> <li>Spread good vibes</li> <li>Build future</li> <li>Do the right thing</li> </ul> <p><em>At Kerv, we’re building something special and we’re building it to last. raw.description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.

We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Clinical Pharmacist at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

At AIOS Tech (Bolt Pharmacy), we're building the world's first full-stack AI doctor. Right now it's akin to assisted self-driving (and improving every day), so humans are prescribing with AI assisting their workflows.

You'll join our growing team of Independent Prescribers, working through GLP-1 weight-management consultations day in, day out. You understand that a great patient experience means catching everything you need to prescribe safely and confidently first time - not sending someone back and forth for information you should have picked up on intake.

You'll assess each patient on their own merits: the comorbidity, the interacting medication, the case that needs a second look, and make the right call. You’ll never compromise on safety or accuracy.

You'll:

  • Deliver safe, evidence-based GLP-1 prescribing for every patient on your list

  • Take full ownership of the clinical quality, safety and accuracy of your own consultations and records

  • Flag anything that needs escalating—a red flag, a near miss, a protocol gap—clearly and quickly

  • Follow, and help sharpen, our clinical protocols as they evolve

This role is suited to a confident, forward-thinking prescriber with sound clinical judgement, excellent attention to detail, and a strong commitment to patient safety.

Great performance in this role means your patients are safe, your records hold up to audit, and you're working through a full, steady caseload without ever cutting corners. If you nail this role, you'll be a strong candidate for more senior clinical positions as we grow.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement - full-time (40h) preferred, part-time (20h+) available - fully remote/WFH or hybrid onsite in Blackburn.

You’ll report directly to your team lead.

You’ll also work most closely with:

  • Noozhat Patel (UK Clinical Operations Lead)

  • Mobeen Nawaz (Clinical Team Lead)

  • Adedayo Titiloye (Deputy Superintendent Pharmacist)

Key Responsibilities

  • Prescribing: Deliver safe, evidence-based GLP-1 prescribing for every patient you see — assessing suitability, comorbidities and contraindications before you write anything.

  • Consultations: Run detailed, efficient consultations that capture everything you need the first time, so patients aren't stuck in back-and-forth messiness.

  • Monitoring: Track treatment response and side effects across your caseload, and adjust care promptly and safely.

  • Escalation: Recognise what's outside your remit, and escalate red flags, near misses or complex cases to your Senior Clinician Team Lead quickly and clearly.

  • Documentation: Keep accurate, concise and contemporaneous clinical records that hold up to audit.

  • Governance: Contribute to clinical audits, incident learning and quality improvement when asked.

  • Collaboration: Work smoothly with customer support, operational and technology teams to keep the service safe and moving in service of our patient base.

Need to Have

  • Registration: GPhC-registered pharmacist with an Independent Prescriber (IP) annotation, held for at least 1 year.

  • GLP-1 Confidence: You've prescribed weight-management, GLP-1s or a closely related area — comorbidities and polypharmacy don't throw you off protocol.

  • Clinical Reasoning: You think clearly and quickly within a protocol-led service.

  • Safety Mindset: Patient safety and quality are non-negotiable for you. Red flags don't get past you.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, including confident patient counselling.

  • Pace: Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-volume, protocol-led environment, and you don't let volume compromise accuracy.

  • Digital Literacy: Confident using electronic health records and remote consultation platforms.

  • Flexibility: Willing to support evening or weekend rotas when needed. With sufficient notice, you work the hours that our patients need you to work so they can be served without long wait times and unnecessary friction.

Nice to Have

  • Consultation Modes: Experience with asynchronous, telephone and/or video consultations.

  • Specialist Training: Additional training in obesity or weight management, such as SCOPE certification.

  • Postgraduate: A postgraduate clinical diploma or equivalent.

  • Complex Patients: Comfortable managing patients with diabetes, cardiovascular disease, renal impairment or polypharmacy.

  • Governance Experience: Some experience contributing to clinical audits, incident investigations or quality-improvement projects.

  • Protocols: Exposure to developing SOPs, clinical protocols or prescribing pathways.

  • Startup Pace: Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, ideally in the weight loss space.

  • Growth Mindset: An interest in eventually mentoring or supporting more junior colleagues as you grow with us.

  • Systems: Familiarity with clinical support and customer management systems.

    🎯 “You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.”

Training and onboarding

  • Training is delivered completely remotely

  • The duration of training is a minimum of 2 days, with scheduling negotiable depending on experience and prior exposure to GLP-1 prescribing or digital health services.

  • Ongoing mentoring and support are provided throughout your induction and practice.

  • Following successful completion of the training period, the role transitions to remote working.

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: £45/hr inc equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well:

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps

  • Coaching: free biweekly health coaching

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

description: About LILT AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality. At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues— Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation , Canva , the United States Department of Defense , the United States Air Force , ASICS , and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI. Where You’ll Work Get the best of both worlds at LILT! Dive into dynamic in-office energy 3 days a week, sparking creativity and forging bonds with your awesome team. Then, seamlessly shift gears and crush your to-do list from the comfort of your home base for the rest of the week. It's the perfect harmony of productivity and personal freedom. Want a peek inside? Visit our Careers page ! This position can be fully remote anywhere in the United States. Candidates based in San Francisco, CA Indianapolis, IN or New York, NY offices will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. This position can be based out of our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Authorization to work in the U.S. / UK is a precondition of employment. What You’ll Do LILT is growing quickly and the Enterprise Account Executive role is core to our success. We are looking for a driven, hard-working, and adaptable sales professional who will propel us to new milestones by leveraging their skills, qualities, and experiences to grow our commercial footprint. You will achieve this by selling our platform and services to new customers while also supporting our Customer Success Managers to expand partnerships with larger customers. While we understand the power of a channel, in order to be successful in this role, you will close your quota through your own outbound efforts. This will require you to be a strong, systematic hunter who uses the latest revenue operations practices and technologies to run the entire sales cycle as well as work in conjunction with our ADR/BDR team. You will build relationships with our champions, business cases with their constituents, and “partnerships” with their businesses. Key Responsibilities: Uncover, educate, and close prospective customers on time and on forecast that meet company metrics and objectives Become an expert in translating the value of our platform and services to all levels and across all functions, including C-level executives, into the language and metrics of the customer in order to sell the outcome impact to business buyers Set-up and deliver winning POCs in order to convert new, long-lasting customers Provide a weekly accounting of your high-gain activities for continuous improvement as well as maintaining an accurate forecast of your total business Sustain high activity levels across all channels employing tailored, multi-thread outreach Skills and Experience: Required: Experience selling in the translation & localization industry (required both technology and services) or SaaS with strong services component and offering. 6+ years of proven ability in managing complex 9-15 month sales cycles to the high-end mid-market and enterprise markets with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota, acquiring new complex and highly competitive accounts and successful revenue attainment Consistently booking $250k - $2M deals and exceeding $1.2M+ in annual quotas Equally effective in getting meetings with target customers independently as well as in conjunction with ADR/BDR teams Experience in sourcing and acting as the lead on RFP response, cross-departmental collaboration, and execution Proficient with leading sales tools such as Salesforce, Linkedin Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, Momentum Experience in account management and collaborating with cross-functional service & delivery teams to influence strategy and creatively solve client’s business problems Skilled at negotiating business terms with line-of-business, procurement and contract teams, senior management and/or C-level executives Proven ability to influence & drive cross-departmental strategy and collaboration (Services, Product, Solutions, Senior Leadership) during deal cycles in creatively solving our client’s business problems Excellent verbal and written communication skills and excels leading in-person meetings and web-based demos Process and solution oriented with a customer mindset and ability to challenge the status quo in order to uncover and prove out multiple land and expand use cases BA or BS degree (preferred) or higher from an accredited university Our Story Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. They were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company and left to start a new company to address this need – LILT. At its core, LILT has always been a machine learning company since its incorporation on March 6, 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, believing that this foundation was imperative to the future of enterprise translation.   • Collaborate with 3rd party UAS vendors and cross-functional teams to bring autonomy software to life on OEM and Applied hardware alike

  • BS or MS in Robotics, Computer Science, or related engineering field

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience working with robotic systems (hardware, software, and integration)

  • Experience integrating with communication busses & protocols: UART/RS232/RS422/RS485, SPI/QSPI, I2C, Ethernet

  • Experience developing in Docker, containerized deployment environments, and using Linux-based operating systems (e.g., RHEL, Ubuntu)

  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-oriented project delivery mindset

description: Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby. I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success. We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward. Role overview: We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you. As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team. Role requirements: UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates. Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place. People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit. Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint. Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently. Compensation Expertise : You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions. Performance Management : You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles. Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees. Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk. You could be a great fit if: 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries 🔑 You take real ownership. We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you.

As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team.

Role requirements:

  • UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates.

  • Performance Management: You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles.

  • Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees.

  • Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk.

  • 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations

  • 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries

  • 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through

  • 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change

  • 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development

  • 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths

  • ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation

  • 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence

  • CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification

description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to shape some of the most important experiences in our marketplace. You'll own complex, high-impact problem spaces end to end, from ambiguous discovery through to shipped, measured outcomes and raise the bar for design craft and pace across the whole team. This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership, mentor other designers, and set the standard for how design work gets done at Carwow. A note on how we work: AI fluency is integral to the role. Our design team works AI-natively. We use Claude Design (and similar tools) to move from idea to high-quality prototype in hours, not weeks, and we expect designers at this level to be genuinely fluent in this way of working, not just curious about it. If you're still designing the way teams did in 2023, this probably isn't the right role. If you've rebuilt your workflow around AI and it's made you dramatically faster and more ambitious, we'd love to talk. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Own end-to-end design for a major problem space in our marketplace. Buying, selling, or dealer-facing products. from discovery and framing through to launch and iteration Prototype at pace using AI design tools (Claude Design or equivalent), getting real, testable experiences in front of users and stakeholders early and often Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, using AI-assisted workflows to close the gap between design intent and shipped product, ideally getting hands-on in code where it speeds things up Set direction, not just execute: identify opportunities, make the case with evidence, and bring product and engineering partners with you Raise the craft bar across the team through critique, mentorship, and by making your own work an example worth following Champion AI-native ways of working. This is critical to the role, and we'll want to see it in your portfolio and hear about it in interviews Strong end-to-end craft: you can go from a fuzzy problem statement to polished, production-ready design, and everything you ship is considered Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You make good decisions with incomplete information and iterate quickly Excellent communication and influence: you can align senior stakeholders, tell a compelling story with your work, and hold your ground constructively Experience mentoring designers and lifting the standard of a team| STRONGLY PREFERRED SKILLS Experience with Claude Code (or an equivalent AI coding agent) — enough to prototype in real code, collaborate more deeply with engineers, or ship small changes yourself Marketplace, e-commerce, or two-sided platform experience Familiarity with experimentation-driven product development (A/B testing, funnel analysis) WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In your first six months you'll have taken ownership of a significant problem space, shipped work that measurably moves a core metric, and become someone other designers seek out — both for the quality of your craft and for how you use AI tools to work at a pace and ambition level others want to copy. WHY CARWOW? Genuine scale and impact: your work is used by millions of car buyers and sellers An AI-forward culture where new tools and workflows are embraced, not resisted — with access to the best tooling available A senior, supportive design team that takes craft seriously Hybrid working, competitive salary and equity, private healthcare, enhanced parental leave, and a car-buying perk you'd expect from us HOW TO APPLY Send us your CV and portfolio. Please include at least one example of work where AI tools (Claude Design, Claude Code, or equivalents) played a meaningful role in your process — tell us what you used, how, and what it changed about the outcome.
