title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. title: Director, Technical Program Management, Networking
description: <h2><strong>About Nscale</strong></h2> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We're seeking a Director of Technical Program Management – Networking to build and lead the team of Technical Program Managers who deliver Nscale's network infrastructure across Europe. This team sits within our Deployment organisation, a build org that owns every step from hardware arrival on site through to customer acceptance.</p> <p>You'll own the delivery of cluster networking, data centre networking, and WAN programmes across our European sites, leading TPMs who partner with Network Engineering, Data Centre Operations, Supply Chain, and external carriers and vendors. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has delivered networks at hyperscale and knows how to turn complex, multi-site builds into predictable, repeatable execution. The role involves regular travel to our sites and partners.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll be Doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, lead, and mentor a team of Technical Program Managers covering cluster networking, data centre networking, and WAN delivery across Europe.</li> <li>Own the end-to-end network delivery plan for new GPU cluster builds and expansions, from hardware arrival through installation, validation, and customer acceptance.</li> <li>Set the operating model for network programme delivery: planning standards, milestone gates, risk and dependency management, and reporting.</li> <li>Partner with Network Engineering on design readiness, BOMs, and build sequencing for Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics, front-end networks, and WAN interconnects.</li> <li>Drive alignment across Deployment, Data Centre Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, SRE, and Commercial teams so network delivery never blocks customer handover.</li> <li>Manage strategic relationships with carriers, IXPs, colocation providers, and network hardware vendors.</li> <li>Establish metrics for delivery speed, quality, and predictability, and use them to drive continuous improvement.</li> <li>Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to executive leadership and customers.</li> <li>Hire top TPM talent in a highly competitive market and grow a high-performing, accountable team culture.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in technical programme management, network engineering, or infrastructure delivery, including 5+ years leading TPM or engineering teams.</li> <li>Track record delivering large-scale network infrastructure at a hyperscaler or major network vendor (e.g. Microsoft, AWS, Oracle/OCI, Cisco, or similar).</li> <li>Strong technical grounding in cluster and data centre networking, WAN, and routing (BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics).</li> <li>Experience running multi-site, multi-country builds with complex hardware, vendor, and carrier dependencies.</li> <li>Proven ability to build programme management frameworks that scale with a fast-growing organisation.</li> <li>Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable influencing without authority.</li> <li>Willingness to travel regularly across Europe to sites and partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience delivering networking for large GPU clusters or AI training environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with HPC network topologies (Fat Tree, Rail) and high-speed optics (400G/800G).</li> <li>Experience with network automation and infrastructure-as-code in a deployment context.</li> <li>PMP, PgMP, or similar certification.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why this role matters</strong></h2> <p>Every GPU we deploy is only as useful as the network that connects it. This role sets how quickly and reliably Nscale turns hardware into capacity our customers can use, and shapes how network delivery scales as we expand across Europe.</p> <h2><strong>Equal Opportunities Statement</strong></h2> <p>At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.</p> <p>If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.</p> <p>The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee &amp; Candidate Privacy Notice:&nbsp;<a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QK5Yg04WHD9K9IAtJgQWubJZC9oLvatK/view?usp=sharing" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QK5Yg04WHD9K9IAtJgQWubJZC9oLvatK/view?usp%3Dsharing&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1765375172804000&amp;usg=AOvVaw2Ncte4rmlGl8OKuFuDgDtx">Here.</a><br><br>Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.<br></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

benefits.</li> <li>Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>What to expect in the hiring process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Application &amp; portfolio description: <p></p> <p><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">(Senior) Scientist, Machine Learning</strong></p> <p><strong>About Quotient Therapeutics</strong><br>Quotient Therapeutics is a Flagship Pioneering company that uses somatic genomics to discover drug targets. We use high-accuracy sequencing to find rare somatic mutations in cells from non-cancerous diseased human tissue. Mutations that help cells survive or expand in a disease environment point to causal biology. We use that evidence to nominate and assess targets, and to decide whether a target should be copied (protective mutations) or opposed (disease-driving mutations).</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong><br>Quotient is seeking a (Senior) Scientist, Machine Learning to build models and AI agents that turn our somatic mutation data into evidence for target discovery. A central question is what a given mutation does to a protein, and whether that effect explains why cells carrying it are selected in disease. You will build models of variant effects on protein function and connect them to genomic, single-cell, perturbation and phenotype data. You will also develop agentic AI workflows that help scientists analyse data, test hypotheses and make decisions.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role on a cross-functional team. You will write clear, tested code, use modern AI tools to work faster, and work closely with the computational scientists, experimental biologists, engineers and target discovery leads who act on your results. The role is based in Cambridge, UK, and is hybrid, with a minimum of 3 days per week in the office.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><span>Build and evaluate models that predict how coding and non-coding variants affect protein function, stability, interactions and pathway activity, using protein language models, structure-based methods and related approaches.</span></li> <li><span>Use variant-effect predictions to interpret somatic selection signals, including whether mutations are likely loss-of-function, gain-of-function or neutral, and where they cluster in protein structure.</span></li> <li><span>Design, build and evaluate AI agents and agentic workflows that retrieve evidence, run analyses and support hypothesis testing and target assessment.</span></li> <li><span>Train, fine-tune or adapt foundation models, language models and representation-learning methods for target discovery.</span></li> <li><span>Use AI coding tools to speed up development while keeping code readable, tested and reproducible.</span></li> <li><span>Work as a core member of cross-functional project teams, share ownership of team goals, and contribute to shared codebases, reviews and tools.</span></li> <li><span>Communicate results clearly to scientists and target discovery leadership, including model assumptions, limitations and next steps.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><span>PhD in machine learning, computer science, computational biology, genomics, bioinformatics, statistics, engineering or a related field, or an MSc with equivalent experience. Level (Scientist or Senior Scientist) will be set based on experience.</span></li> <li><span>Strong Python skills and experience building practical deep learning systems (e.g. PyTorch, JAX).</span></li> <li><span>Experience training, evaluating or applying ML models to complex real-world biological data.</span></li> <li><span>Understanding of how genetic variants affect protein structure and function, and experience with variant-effect prediction methods (e.g. protein language models such as ESM, structure-based models, or tools such as AlphaMissense).</span></li> <li><span>Regular use of AI coding assistants, LLM-based workflows or agentic development tools in your own work.</span></li> <li><span>Depth in one or more of the following: biomedical foundation models, AI agents, Perturb-seq or single-cell genomics, genotype–phenotype modelling, causal inference, perturbation modelling, or large-scale biological datasets.</span></li> <li><span>Proven ability to work in cross-functional teams and to explain technical results to non-specialists.</span></li> <li><span>Evidence of technical depth through papers, thesis work, open-source projects, industry projects or substantial applied research.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Values and Behaviours</strong></p> <ul> <li><span>Encourage respectful disagreement and cultivate open-minded, ego-free interactions to continuously push each other towards excellence</span></li> <li><span>Seek out diverse perspectives; practice active listening and genuine curiosity to ensure all contributions are valued, regardless of source</span></li> <li><span>Recognize the impact of your behavior, language and attitudes, and strive for balanced, meaningful exchanges that enhance mutual growth and understanding in all interactions</span></li> <li><span>Use a company-first mindset to guide decision-making; prioritize team over individual success</span></li> <li><span>Take calculated risks and challenge convention in the quest for exceptional outcomes</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>About Quotient:</strong></p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics is a privately-held, early stage company developing breakthrough medicines informed by natural somatic genetic diversity present in patients. Through our work in somatic genomics, we are forging a new status quo for biopharma research and development across a broad pipeline of internal and partnered programs.&nbsp;</p> <p>The company was founded by Flagship Pioneering, an innovative enterprise that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Flagship Pioneering has created over 100 groundbreaking companies over the past twenty years, all of which are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna (MRNA), Generate Biomedicines, Sana Biotechnology (SANA), Tessera Therapeutics, Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), Indigo Agriculture, Seres Therapeutics (MCRB), and Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS).</p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics and Flagship Pioneering are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.</p> <p><strong>Recruitment &amp; Staffing Agencies:</strong></p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics (“Quotient”) and Flagship Pioneering (“FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Quotient, FSP or their employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Privacy Notice for Applicants:&nbsp;</strong>When you apply for a role at Flagship Pioneering or one of its portfolio companies, we collect and use personal information you provide (such as your name, contact details, work history, and application materials) to evaluate your application, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. title: Account Director, Maritime
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong><br><br>Anduril Maritime delivers platforms, systems and integrated effects in the maritime domain. Autonomous vehicles are central to these capabilities, with sustained emphasis on endurance, autonomy and mission capability. In Australia, the team’s work centres on Dive-XL. The Australian program spans the platform, payloads, autonomy and the supporting enterprise required to field and sustain the capability, delivered with an Australian workforce and an Australian supply chain, in close partnership with the Commonwealth.<br><br><strong>ABOUT THE JOB</strong><br><br>As Account Director - Maritime you will support Anduril’s customer engagement for Dive-XL in Australia. You will be a key stakeholder in the Australian customer relationship and a principal voice of the customer within the product organisation, working across the Royal Australian Navy (RAN), Naval Shipbuilding and Sustainment Group (NSSG), Defence Science and Technology (DST) Group and the Commonwealth departments that shape, sponsor and fund the program. You will operate as part of a broader engagement team spanning Growth, Programs, Engineering and Contracts rather than as the sole interface to the customer. The role combines operational background, capability development experience and commercial judgement. You will be credible discussing autonomy behaviours and payload trade-offs with engineering teams, familiar with how capability requirements are developed, contested and funded within Defence, and conversant with the ASDEFCON framework through which intent becomes contracted scope. This is a senior, externally facing role in which your operational judgement and customer insight will directly inform how an autonomous undersea capability is defined, developed and deployed.</p> <p><strong>Internal Interfaces</strong><br>Product Director, XL-AUV: You report to the Product Director and provide prioritised customer and operational input to the Dive-XL roadmap, ensuring that Australian requirements are represented in product decisions and that customer commitments remain consistent with the capability plan.<br><br>SEA1200 Program Director: The Account Director and the SEA1200 Program Director operate as a partnership across the same program. The Program Director owns contract execution and the delivery organisation that performs it; you own the customer interface, keeping the contract sold and creating the conditions to extend it. Both roles work from a shared understanding of commitments, delivery performance and customer expectations, and neither succeeds without the other.<br><br>Growth and Global Defence: You work with the Growth organisation and Anduril’s Global Defence teams to identify, qualify and support capture opportunities, aligning Australian pursuits with wider international campaigns and ensuring that positioning in Australia is consistent with the company’s global approach to allied undersea programs.<br><br>Engineering, Programs and Test and Evaluation: You provide the operational context behind requirements and represent the customer’s perspective in design, trials and acceptance discussions, so that engineering effort remains anchored to real warfighting problems.<br><br><br><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Commonwealth Relationships: Contribute to Anduril’s engagement across the RAN, NSSG, and the Commonwealth departments that shape, sponsor and fund the program, from capability sponsors through to the operators who will take the vehicle to sea.</li> <li>Engagement Rhythm: Support a disciplined cadence of briefings, capability forums, working groups and demonstrations across classified and unclassified environments, so that Anduril’s standing with the customer is institutional rather than personal.</li> <li>Voice of the Customer: Act as a principal channel between the customer and Anduril, conveying customer intent within the company and representing our capability accurately outside it.</li> <li>Employment Concepts: Contribute to the development of employment concepts and CONOPS for autonomous undersea capability in the Australian context, and to a shared understanding of how the RAN intends to operate the capability.</li> <li>Operational Need into Product Requirement: Distil operational analysis, threat assessments and customer intent into clear, prioritised capability needs, and provide substantiated input to the Dive-XL roadmap in partnership with product and engineering leadership.</li> <li>Capture Support: Support the growth path from current contracts toward fleet scale. Contribute to early requirement shaping and to responses to Commonwealth approaches to market, working with Growth, Global Defence, Programs, Contracts and Legal within the ASDEFCON environment.</li> <li>Alignment to Product Strategy: Work with the Product Director to keep contract execution and customer commitments aligned to the capability roadmap, identifying and escalating misalignment early.</li> <li>Trials and Demonstrations: Support customer engagement around trials, demonstrations and milestone events, ensuring that what is demonstrated is represented accurately and consistently.</li> <li>Global Product Line: Represent Australian customer interests within the wider Dive-XL portfolio, and carry lessons from Australian activity into US, AUKUS and allied engagement.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Programs, Support Systems, Test and Evaluation, Contracts, Growth and Communications to present a coherent and consistent Anduril to the customer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operational Background: Extensive RAN warfare experience with a demonstrated operational record at sea. A submarine background is strongly preferred; a Principal Warfare Officer with undersea warfare experience will be equally considered.</li> <li>Navy Capability Experience: Experience within a capability manager, force design, or requirements role, including developing and defending a capability requirement through the Defence process.</li> <li>Established Network: An existing network across Navy, Defence and the Australian undersea enterprise, with a demonstrated ability to build and sustain trusted relationships at senior levels.</li> <li>Communication and Presence: Ability to establish trust quickly and to communicate complex concepts to audiences ranging from software engineers to flag officers.</li> <li>International Experience: Allied exchange, coalition operations, or overseas posting, with the standing to operate credibly alongside US and UK partners.</li> <li>ASDEFCON Familiarity: Working knowledge of the ASDEFCON environment and Commonwealth approaches to market, including the ability to review a Statement of Work and identify areas of technical or delivery risk.</li> <li>Technical Literacy: Sufficient technical depth to engage substantively on autonomy, mission systems, payloads and undersea employment concepts, and to participate in trade-off discussions with engineering teams. This role requires both customer-facing experience and genuine technical depth.</li> <li>Commercial Judgement: Experience shaping scope, developing the case for investment, and understanding how a capability decision becomes a funded program.</li> <li>Pace and Ownership: A high-ownership approach with a strong bias for action, and a demonstrated ability to speak Commonwealth and move at Anduril pace in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required, approximately 30%, including to trials and waterfront activity.</li> <li>Must be able to obtain and maintain a NV2 security clearance. TSPV desirable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>RAN submarine service at command, executive officer, or watch-leader qualified level.</li> <li>Deep undersea warfare subject-matter expertise with an operational background.</li> <li>Direct experience with uncrewed or autonomous systems in an operational or capability development context.</li> <li>Prior experience within the Australian Submarine Agency, Navy Capability Division, NSSG,</li> <li>ASCA, or AUKUS Pillar 1 / Pillar 2 structures.</li> <li>Existing relationships across allied undersea programs and partner navies.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. SWQOps, especially our Technical Specialists, plays a critical role in this expansion, making it possible to scale safely and efficiently. We are on the front lines of:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>International RO &amp; New Market Readiness: Concerted effort to update triage policy, standing Voice of Customer in new countries. Through meticulous triage of driving events, issue discovery, and continuous field monitoring, SWQOps provides early warnings and critical insights to Product and Data Science partners.</li> <li>Supporting the development of a single, automated, end-to-end machine learning flywheel for the entire Waymo Driver. A successful flywheel will be the core engine for scaling our technology, enabling faster international expansion, quicker remediation of driving issues, and a significant reduction in the engineering effort required to maintain and improve the driver.</li> <li>Driving Engineering Velocity: By handling the vital work of performance evaluation, issue deep-dives, and data set curation, SWQOps collaborates heavily and allows Waymo's Engineering, SysEng, Simulation, and Data Science teams to focus on their core tasks of developing and improving the Waymo Driver.&nbsp;</li> <li>Workflow Incubation &amp; Development: Incubating high-impact workflows and ensuring readiness for automation and long-term operational excellence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Engineering to design, test, and deploy cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (Gen-AI) models and tools to drive step-change improvements in issue discovery &amp; detection, triage efficiency, and quality assurance. You'll be at the forefront of identifying and escalating issues with our tools, providing technical requirements to engineering, and driving user testing to support the development and deployment of new tooling features.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS/BA degree in a technical or analytical field, or 5+ years of relevant work experience in Autonomous Vehicles (AV), Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS), automotive systems engineering, robotics, or complex technical software operations.</li> <li>Active, valid driver's license with extensive personal on-road driving experience and a thorough understanding of driving rules, roadway design, and regulations in European metropolitan areas, specifically under the German (StVO) and/or Spanish (DGT) traffic frameworks.</li> <li>Increased competency in supporting all phases of the machine learning development lifecycle, from data preparation and training to validation, deployment, and continuous monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with ML testing and validation, including dataset quality assurance, bias detection, edge-case scenario testing, and performance evaluation using statistical metrics.</li> <li>Ability to quickly learn and implement new concepts, analyze data logs using 3D visualization platforms, and utilize proprietary tools. Strong understanding of driving rules and regulations.</li> <li>A proven ability to work in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining good judgment and navigating technical ambiguity.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with a wide range of individuals in a diverse and dynamic work environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>We prefer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated strong execution with ability to drive outcomes in new environments, from early-stage to maturity&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong communication skills in German&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working with international and/or offshore vendor teams to drive global process standardization and quality</li> <li>Analytic skills and basic SQL querying</li> <li>Competency in LLM / transformer models, and / or ML for robotics domain experience</li> <li>A greater focus on using your subject matter expertise for results analysis and direct customer consultation in the development of new and improved solutions</li> <li>Self-motivated with basic skills in task planning and time management</li> <li>Experience with project management or program management in a global, distributed environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The expected base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. You’ll play a critical role in supporting the GM of Payments and the leadership team to define, measure, and drive our strategy - balancing long-term vision with the realities of day-to-day delivery.</p> <p>This is a high-ownership, high-impact role, ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex problems, is fuelled by strategic thinking, and enjoys using data to bring clarity to ambiguity. You’ll move seamlessly between blue-sky thinking and tactical execution - one day modelling the impact of a new product bet, the next helping optimise how we run the collective.</p> <p>You’ll bring a birds-eye view across Payments’s portfolio - ensuring our goals, investments, and initiatives line up coherently with each other and with Monzo’s broader mission. And you’ll be the connective tissue that keeps us operating effectively: tracking performance, surfacing insights, and making sure we’re focused on what really matters.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Driving strategic clarity:</strong> Supporting the GM of Payments and leadership team in defining, tracking, and evolving Payments’s strategic direction to align with Monzo’s wider mission</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Problem Solving:</strong> Actively dive into large, complex datasets to uncover insights, diagnose operational challenges, and independently design and implement scalable solutions.</li> <li><strong>Translating data into action:</strong> Building and maintaining data-informed views of performance across products, squads, and initiatives; using insights to inform priorities and trade-offs</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration: </strong>Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Design teams to bridge the gap between ideas and strategic business execution</li> <li><strong>Owning business performance rhythm:</strong> Leading monthly business reviews, reporting, and governance materials to keep the collective aligned and accountable</li> <li><strong>Shaping new opportunities:</strong> Scoping new bets through market sizing, commercial modelling, partnerships evaluation, and budget/forecast analysis</li> <li><strong>Making the org more effective:</strong> Optimising how we balance KTLO, BAU, and growth work; supporting resourcing and squad setup decisions across the collective</li> <li><strong>Connecting the dots:</strong> Ensuring consistent communication and alignment across Payment squads, and with other Monzo collectives</li> <li><strong>Scale &amp; Geographic Expansion:</strong> Playing a pivotal role in scaling our lending book and supporting launch operations as we expand our Borrowing products into new geographies</li> <li><strong>Bringing teams together:</strong> Leading Payments All Hands, goals processes, and strategic forums that ensure cohesion and momentum across the collective</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you have...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Acumen:</strong> You have a deeply strategic mind, capable of seeing the bigger picture, thinking in systems, and anticipating future trends</li> <li><strong>Exceptional Problem-Solving Skills: </strong>Your “superpower” is solving complex problems with analytical rigor, commercial viability, and execution certainty</li> <li><strong>Adaptability &amp; Ownership:</strong> You’re a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, adept at navigating complex, rapidly evolving environments, and driven by impact and ownership</li> <li><strong>Collaboration &amp; Influencing Without Authority:</strong> You have an exceptional ability to connect the dots across different parts of the business, foster collaboration, and drive alignment without authority</li> <li><strong>Commercial Mindset:</strong> You’re comfortable making trade-offs and prioritisation decisions based on data, business impact, and resource constraints</li> <li><strong>Analytical Rigour</strong>: A strong analytical skillset with a proven track record of comfortably navigating large datasets to solve unstructured problems independently</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Mindset: </strong>Experience working cross-functionally with highly technical teams such as Machine Learning and Data/Analytics Engineering</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence:</strong> You’re motivated by improving how teams work - finding ways to make organisations more efficient, scalable, and focused on what matters most</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>💰 £86,100 - £101,300 (depending on experience) + incentive awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍 We're open to distributed working within the UK, with the expectation of working from the London office on occasional basis.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.&nbsp;</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.&nbsp;</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h3><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Phone call with Recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Initial behavioural video call with Hiring Manager (45 mins)</li> <li>Analytical interview (60 mins)</li> <li>Problem solving interview (60 mins)</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.<br><br>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">here</a>.<br><br>#LI-NZ1 #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. raw.title: Enablement Lead
raw.description:
About Wordsmith
Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we're growing fast.

In-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one place: requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. More than 500 companies use Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage. We're backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others.

The role

We're hiring an Enablement Lead to own how customers learn Wordsmith, and how they become confident, self-sufficient users of it.

You'll own onboarding, training and enablement end to end: Legal AI fundamentals, product and feature overviews, self-paced certifications, and re-enablement for customers who've stalled. You'll teach both ends of the customer organisation: the lawyers and business users in Wordsmith every day, and the champions and admins who support their colleagues.

This is an enablement role, not a delivery or commercial one. You won't own implementation, technical support, renewals, account growth or a sales quota. Your focus is capability: do customers know how to use Wordsmith well, and can they keep learning without us?

What you'll do

  • Own customer onboarding. Design and run the journey that takes a newly implemented customer to a confident, capable team, and keep improving it.

  • Teach Legal AI fundamentals. Build the curriculum that helps legal teams understand what AI agents do well, where judgement stays with them, and how to work alongside the technology.

  • Run live training. Lead onboarding sessions, product walkthroughs and feature deep dives for lawyers, business users and admins of every technical confidence level.

  • Build the self-paced academy. Create online certifications and learning paths so customers can train new joiners and refresh skills on their own.

  • Maintain the enablement library. Keep guides and product overviews accurate as Wordsmith ships, and retire what's out of date.

  • Re-enable struggling customers. Diagnose why adoption has stalled and run focused programmes that get teams back to self-sufficiency.

  • Train the champions. Equip customer champions and admins to teach their own colleagues, so capability compounds inside each account.

  • Shape in-app help. Work with Product to build guidance, walkthroughs and prompts into Wordsmith itself.

  • Measure whether learning worked. Define what a trained, self-sufficient customer looks like, track it, and use the evidence to change what we teach.

  • Partner across customer teams. Work with Transformation, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product so enablement reflects real implementations, questions and product changes.

What we're looking for

  • 3–5 years in customer enablement, training, onboarding, customer education, implementation or a similar customer-facing role where teaching was central.

  • You design learning, not just deliver it. You can turn a complex product into a curriculum with a clear sequence and outcomes.

  • Confidence in front of a room, in person and on video, with senior lawyers as readily as with day-to-day users.

  • Experience building self-paced content (courses, certifications, guides, video) and a view on what makes people finish it.

  • A clear, warm communication style that makes unfamiliar ideas easy to grasp without oversimplifying them.

  • Strong organisation: you can run several programmes, sessions and content deadlines at once without losing detail.

  • Comfort with data. You can read product-usage information, spot where learning hasn't landed and act on it.

  • Curiosity about AI and legal technology. You don't need a legal background, but you'll want to learn the product and our customers' work deeply.

  • A strong learning mindset: you welcome feedback, apply coaching and want to grow quickly.

How we work

We're an in-person team in Edinburgh, so expect to work from the office or visit customers by default. We set a high bar, move quickly and give people real ownership. There won't always be a playbook, so you'll bring curiosity, structure and persistence.

You'll work closely with the VP of Transformation and with Customer Success, Account Management and Product. Each customer team has a clear remit:

  • Transformation leads implementation

  • Support Engineering resolves technical issues

  • Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth

  • Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation

  • Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability

Why join Wordsmith

Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding inside larger organisations. Because Legal AI is new to almost everyone who buys it, teaching it well is one of the highest-leverage things we can do.

You'll join early enough to define what customer enablement at Wordsmith is: the curriculum, the certifications, and the standard for what a confident user looks like. You'll work directly with ambitious legal teams, learn the product deeply and develop fast in a high-performing team.

What You’ll Do

  • Translating multi-LOB demand forecasts into monthly and quarterly capacity, headcount, and budget requirements.

  • Modeling workforce and financial trade-offs across internal FTEs, BPO partners, overtime spend, bonus hours, productivity shifts, and shrinkage.

  • Analyzing demand-funnel changes (e.g., product feature rollouts, AI bot deflection shifts) and quantifying their exact capacity and dollar blast radius.

  • Partnering directly with Finance, Product, and Operations to validate baseline assumptions, enforce input SLAs, and align on staffing commitments.

  • Drafting concise, decision-ready executive memos and Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) for Directors and leadership.

  • Conducting deep-dive root-cause analyses whenever operational actuals deviate from capacity plans and establishing corrective action paths.

  • Standardizing capacity planning frameworks, modeling templates, and operating standards across LOBs.

  • Maintaining deep forecasting competency to audit models, challenge underlying assumptions, and provide seamless coverage across the broader central WFM engine.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Strategic WFM Math: Exceptionally strong quantitative background with deep expertise in WFM fundamentals (capacity modeling, Erlang, shrinkage, AHT, SLA/ASA trade-offs) and advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, SQL, or Python.

title: Supply Chain Lead
description: Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows. We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us. Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination.    🛠️  Procurement Team @ Bloom & Wild Group You’ll be joining the engine room of Bloom & Wild’s fastest-growing categories. While we are known for our flowers, our Procurement team provides the operational and supply chain foundation for our non-horticultural range. From fresh-baked treats and luxury hamper components to home, lifestyle, and the essential packaging that delivers the "wow" moment.  Our team is divided into two clear pillars: Strategic Procurement and Stock Planning. As the Supply Chain Lead, you will report to the Head of Procurement & Inventory, acting as the architect of our operational procurement function and building the scalable systems we need to grow. We are a team that "cares wildly" about impact. Working closely with partners across the business, we ensure the infrastructure is in place to support their vision. Our focus is on delivering perfect availability, optimising inventory health, and enabling rapid range expansion through robust operational processes. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a function from the ground up and see your work directly fuel our success as we scale.  ⚙️ What you'll be doing: Build & Scale the Function You’ll be the architect of our non-horticultural stock planning strategy. This is a "build from scratch" opportunity where you will set the vision for how we scale, demonstrating the ability to turn rapid business growth into a sophisticated, high-performing operational machine Master Stock Availability: You will lead your team to ensure optimal stock levels across all sites, balancing high availability with the need to minimise waste and holding costs. Navigating multi-site space constraints, you’ll work in lockstep with our Warehouse teams and Strategic Procurement Managers to ensure our supply is as efficient as it is reliable. Develop & Automate: Build scalable, custom, automated supply chain and inventory tools and develop AI workflows to eliminate manual data entry and calculation tasks. You will lead the development of  agile, spreadsheet-based solutions while mapping the transition to long-term, robust systems. Process & KPI Leadership Develop standardised processes and frameworks, leading weekly KPI reviews to shift the function from reactive problem-solving to proactive inventory and risk management. You’ll define what "success" looks like for the department. Team Transformation & Development Provide oversight, coaching, and mentorship to a team of stock planners, transitioning them from manual execution to analytical decision-making. You will build internal succession and resilience, ensuring the team is equipped to handle increasing complexity. Strategic Growth & Inventory Control De-risk the launch of new ranges by ensuring our operational infrastructure is mature enough to handle increased SKU counts. You'll collaborate with the commercial team to ensure right-size inventory levels to protect availability, de-risk peak periods, and release trapped cash, while developing third-party relationships (charities/discounters) to manage excess stock. Operational Execution: Support with planning and execution when needed to ensure continuity (especially when issues occur or in peak times) 3PW Performance Management: Measure and manage performance of our 3PW partner against agreed SLA terms Supplier Performance:  Build internal operational performance reporting and supplier tiering, put in place initiatives to improve operational supplier performance.  ✅ You’ll love this role if you… Experience in a procurement, purchasing, supply chain or supply planning role, with experience leading a team Have a proven track record in supply chain scalability - You have experience managing exponential growth of SKUs by using technology and automation to absorb increasing complexity Are tech-savvy and systems-oriented - You have strong capabilities in building automated tools using G-suite and other platforms, and have been leveraging AI to increase your impact in this area Are a strong leader and mentor - You excel at coaching team members, fostering a performance culture centered around accountability and ownership of results and know how to manage your stakeholders effectively.  Have a continuous improvement mindset - You are adept at identifying system limitations and establishing continuous feedback loops with your team to resolve and automate them further Are proactive and hands-on - You are willing to be a direct contributor to enable scale , rolling up your sleeves to understand operational tasks to a high standard and covering gaps during peak periods or illness Are commercially and data-driven  You are motivated by protecting margins, eliminating P&L leakage driven by manual errors, and right sizing inventory levels to optimise working capital and cash flow.   These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you. 🏡 Belonging @ Bloom & Wild We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers.  We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team.  Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working.     🧭 Our ways of working We really believe in the power of connection. For us that looks different depending on the team you work in. Some of our teams work together in person every day, whereas others may connect in person every quarter.  We also believe in flexibility that supports you, the work you do, and your team.  How much you work from home and from our office depends on a balance of those needs, and you’ll agree this with your manager. Whether it’s through a shared project, a learning and development opportunity, or an afterwork social - we trust our teams to make the right decisions (for them and us) about where and how they work each day.   We’re big on collaboration, empathy, knowledge sharing and growth, and our values drive our priorities every day:   Lead change for good: we have the guts to try new things and step up to do what matters most Think deeply, act swiftly : we make sure there’s thoughtful rationale behind our approach and always act swiftly to implement ideas  Care wildly: we pour care and creativity into everything we do and pay attention to the things that make a difference Stay open, be curious:   we’re open about what we’re doing and why, and we welcome challenges from each other   🌟 Work that works for you To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day.    Our perks and benefits include: ⏰ Flexible working & work from abroad  🌴 25 days holiday + your birthday + flexible bank holidays, & option to buy additional holiday each year 💛 1 Volunteering day each year 🐣 Enhanced family leave and a workplace nursery scheme 🌱 A flexible training framework for every stage of your career  💐 Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions! 📈 Share in our success with a choice to take equity options from day 1 🏋 ClassPass membership: monthly credits to spend on fitness classes, yoga and much more!    For more information on our perks & bens, please see www.bloomandwild.com/careers   🫱‍🫲 Getting hired We know that job searching can be daunting, and we want to do everything we can to ensure that your experience with us is a good one. Interviewing is a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’re the right move for you.    We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help you flourish throughout your application process with us, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience.    #Bloom&Wild Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description: <h2><strong>Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)</strong></h2> <h2><strong>The opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly <strong>3,000 people</strong> work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.</p> <p>More than <strong>500,000 healthcare professionals</strong> use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately <strong>90 million people</strong> across Europe.</p> <p>For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an <strong>AI-powered Health Companion</strong> that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.</p> <p>This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.</p> <p>We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.</p> <h2><strong>What you will build and lead</strong></h2> <p>As <strong>Product Design Director, Patient</strong>, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:</p> <ul> <li>access to care, search and booking;</li> <li>patient messaging and teleconsultation;</li> <li>the Patient Health Record and patient context;</li> <li>the app homepage and daily health experience;</li> <li>health content and prevention;</li> <li>recommendations, reminders and care plans;</li> <li>new patient services and subscription experiences;</li> <li>conversational and AI-powered experiences.</li> </ul> <p>The current team includes <strong>six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer</strong>. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.</p> <h2><strong>Your mandate</strong></h2> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.</li> <li>Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.</li> <li>Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.</li> <li>Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.</li> <li>Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.</li> <li>Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.</li> <li>Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.</li> <li>Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.</li> <li>Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.</li> <li>Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>In your first year, you will have:</p> <ul> <li>established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;</li> <li>raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;</li> <li>helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;</li> <li>strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;</li> <li>developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;</li> <li>helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for</strong></h2> <p>You are likely to bring:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..</li> <li>Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.</li> <li>A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.</li> <li>Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.</li> <li>Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.</li> <li>Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.</li> <li>A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.</li> <li>Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.</li> <li>The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.</li> <li>A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.</li> <li>Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.</li> <li>Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.</li> <li>A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Doctolib, why now?</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.</p> <p>The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.</p> <p>You will join at a defining moment:</p> <ul> <li>Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.</li> <li>AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.</li> <li>The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.</li> <li>The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.</li> <li>The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.</li> </ul> <p>This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of <strong>consumer product design, healthcare and AI</strong>, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. If you have a disability, please let us know how we can make the recruitment process more accessible.</em></p> <p><em>Information submitted through this application is processed by Doctolib for recruitment purposes. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team . This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions. What you’ll be doing Design, build and operate the Scala services that connect Ledger wallets and the Ledger Enterprise platform to blockchain backends: account creation, operation history, transaction crafting, broadcast and lifecycle tracking. Lead new blockchain integrations end to end, from the integration design (ADR) to production, across account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains. Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients. Define clear contracts with the Coin Integration and Ledger Enterprise teams, for example where UTXO selection lives or how transaction states are exposed to consumers. Write and review ADRs, challenge designs, and raise the bar on code quality, testing (including end-to-end on testnets) and technical debt management. Work in an AI-native way: use coding agents daily, write the specifications, constraints and verification that let them deliver safely, and contribute to the team's AI tooling. Mentor other engineers and share your knowledge across the Backend Blockchain community. You will collaborate cross-functionally with: The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations. The Ledger Enterprise team, main consumer of the team's services for institutional custody. The Ledger Wallet, Ledger Button and Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs. The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming. The Infrastructure and SRE teams for deployment, reliability and scalability. The Security team (Donjon) for vulnerability analysis and remediation. The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements. What we’re looking for 5+ years of backend engineering, with real production ownership of distributed systems. Strong production experience Interest for Scala and functional programming practice Hands-on blockchain integration experience: transaction lifecycle, fees, finality, reorgs, on at least two models among account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains. Experience with event-driven systems and data infrastructure (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, NATS or equivalent) and with observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent). Able to diagnose an incident across several services and own the outcome, from root cause to fix in production. Comfortable reading and contributing to TypeScript code, as the team works on a polyglot stack. Daily use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output. Clear written communication in English, especially for design documents and incident reports. At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to: Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance. Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work. Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation. Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee. For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information. We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
description: Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales? Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone. What we do We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks. Who We Are CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together. Role As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. title: Enterprise Account Executive (Paris. France)
description: <p>SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.</p> <p>As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.</p> <p>This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.</p> <h2>Role and Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.</li> <li>Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.</li> <li>Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.</li> <li>Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.</li> <li>Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.</li> <li>Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.</li> <li>Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.</li> <li>Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.</li> <li>Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.</li> <li>Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.</li> <li>Travel within the assigned territory as required.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Required Skills and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.</li> <li>Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.</li> <li>Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.</li> <li>Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.</li> <li>Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.</li> <li>Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.</li> <li>Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.</li> <li>Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.</li> <li>B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.</li> <li>Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.</li> <li><strong>Fluent in French and/or German</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
